recommendation: Keep the source fix. Treat any later cleanup of the dropped Media folder or the historical valueset-dicom-dcim fixup as a separate retired-resource or build-configuration task, not part of this active Composition correction.
issue_request: FHIR-22483 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I request to have core use DICOM-published FHIR CodeSystems and ValueSets, using DICOM CID-29 as the example and asking whether fhir.ini/build inputs should point at those DICOM resources.
initial_application: No source commit directly mentioning FHIR-22483 was found. Related FHIR-24908 work in commit 26f1439636ec3a00a96ffe742b9f5cba1ac1a8ba switched ImagingStudy and AuditEvent-related terminology to DICOM-authored value sets and removed duplicate local DICOM value set files, but current source/composition/valueset-doc-event-code.xml still imported http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/dicom-cid29.
additional_context: The issue-linked Zulip thread shows John Moehrke asking whether fhir.ini should point to DICOM-published resources and later discussion confirming DICOM's chtml CID URLs are the ValueSet canonicals. FHIR-I minutes record FHIR-22483 as Persuasive 13-0-0. Composition is active in source/fhir.ini, while the parallel Media value set occurrence is in a dropped resource folder and was not edited.
reconciliation: Changed source/composition/valueset-doc-event-code.xml to import http://dicom.nema.org/medical/dicom/current/output/chtml/part16/sect_CID_29.html. This is the DICOM-published CID-29 URL present in the local fhir.dicom package and removes the only active-source stale dicom-cid29 import found in the inspected DICOM terminology locations.

related_jiras.note: Published technical correction that applied the broader AuditEvent and ImagingStudy move from local DICOM-derived value sets to DICOM-published vocabulary, but did not cover the active Composition value set fixed here.
Earlier CID-29 URL issue confirming the DICOM chtml CID-29 page as the intended URL; already represented on the combined branch by its own audit commit.
